description: This Java class implements a method interceptor for tenant-aware equality and hash code logic, used within the Fineract framework to ensure object comparisons consider tenant context.

classes.name: TenantAwareEqualsHashCodeAdvice
classes.description: A method interceptor that customizes equality and hash code methods to include tenant context information for objects managed in a multi-tenant environment.

methods.name: TenantAwareEqualsHashCodeAdvice
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the target object and retrieves the tenant identifier from thread-local context.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Intercepts method calls to override equals and hashCode methods, ensuring tenant context is considered during comparison.
